Job Title: Account Executive
Experience: 0-2 years
Location: Fully remote within India.

Mandatory Skills:
- B2B Sales
- Salesforce
- CRM
- Lead Generation

Good to have:
- Negotiation
- Key Account Management
- HubSpot

Responsibilities:
- Join Novara Growth Partners, a fast-growing B2B SaaS sales consultancy, as an Account Executive focused on acquiring and nurturing small- to mid-market clients across India.
- Use CRM best practices and Salesforce to manage leads, track pipeline, and maintain accurate opportunity records from initial contact through closure.
- Execute outbound and inbound Lead Generation activities including cold outreach, qualification calls, email campaigns, and social selling to build a steady pipeline.
- Conduct discovery calls and product demonstrations tailored to prospect needs, clearly articulating business value and ROI.
- Collaborate with sales engineering, marketing, and customer success teams to develop proposals, coordinate trials, and ensure seamless handoffs.
- Maintain timely follow-up and forecasting to meet individual sales targets and contribute to team revenue goals.
- Continuously refine sales messaging and processes by feeding market feedback into CRM and participating in weekly pipeline reviews.
- Participate in training programs to expand product knowledge and sales skills; leverage HubSpot where applicable and apply Negotiation and Key Account Management techniques when handling larger or strategic accounts.
